preconditions.description: The input string S is non-empty, contains only lowercase letters, and has length up to 10^5.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L1 <= R1 <= len(S) for L1, R1, _, _ in queries) and all(1 <= L2 <= R2 <= len(S) for _, _, L2, R2 in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query (L1, R1, L2, R2), the indices are valid and within the bounds of the string S.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == 'Yes' if S[L1-1:R1] == S[L2-1:R2] else stdout_line == 'No' for stdout_line, (L1, R1, L2, R2) in zip(output_lines, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (L1, R1, L2, R2), the output line is 'Yes' if the substring S[L1..R1] equals S[L2..R2], otherwise it is 'No'.
